notes.setup: Run 'npm install' in repo root after cloning to install pdf-export dependencies
notes.github_pat: Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in mcp/.mcp.json or as env variable
notes.filesystem_path: Update the filesystem MCP path in mcp/.mcp.json to your actual repo path
notes.firecrawl_key: Required for JD fetching, company profiling, candidate research. Get key at firecrawl.dev — use sparingly
